purpose: Post-validation mechanistic failure inspection; selected cases, not another benchmark.
scoring: ARI on the model observation grid. Labels provide only the guided state count during fitting.
objective_probe: ELBO per point from 16 fixed training-context windows, 4 posterior samples, seed [441,7]. Compare stages of the same representation only.
provenance_note: Initial nine probes preceded addition of the controlled cluster-assignment flag and derivative-sign score. Neither addition changes their training. Derivative scores were subsequently computed from saved arrays. The tenth fit uses that controlled flag. All ten have the identical recorded detector implementation fingerprint. The replay scripts verify fitted sources and weight paths/shapes.
limitations: Selected failures and a small number of seeds; these diagnostics do not establish population effects.
No full reproduction of the original multi-trajectory corpus, architectures or training schedule.
Objective probes evaluate training observations, not held-out likelihood.
Latent/observed k-means are diagnostic alternatives; their reference scores do not enter fitting or checkpoint selection.
Probe overhead makes fit timings unsuitable for speed comparisons.
The conditional mean decoder is a plug-in approximation. Monte Carlo replay averages probabilities under q(z|x), not exact p(z|x).
